verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents that high-end machine types such as NVIDIA H100 require a request for approval. That is a gating limit with an implied raise path. It also documents some per-machine limits, such as storage resizable up to 2 TB. There is no evidence of documented account quotas, instance-count limits or a defined quota-increase workflow. Missing for 10: documented account/team quotas and instance-count limits, a defined step-by-step limit-increase process (form, SLA, API), a quota visibility dashboard, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process

citations.quote: If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
You can resize the machine’s storage up to 2 TB.
